messages:
eval-bot: Nightly eval alert (structured-output-suite) — model redwood/ceres-7b-int8-v2 failing.

Details: 12% schema failures vs baseline 0.8%. Suite: structured-output (JSON schema checks). Link: https://ci.redwood.infra/alerts/2723456789 :eyes:

devin: Assigned severity P2. Who's available to own initial triage?

anika: I'll take it. Will triage reproducer and sample outputs.

liam: Quick repro command I'm running locally:
```
./scripts/run_eval.sh --suite structured-output --model redwood/ceres-7b-int8-v2 --seed 42 --batch 8
```

sam: Pasting a couple failing examples (expected vs actual):
```
PROMPT: generate invoice JSON for order 8345
EXPECTED: {"order":8345,"items":[{"sku":"A1","qty":2}],"total":19.98}
ACTUAL: {"order":8345,"items":[{"sku":"A1","qty":2}],"total":19.98
```
(note missing closing brace and trailing newline, causing schema validator to throw)

maya: Interesting — fp16 variant (ceres-7b-fp16) passes on same prompts. Suspect quantized decoder emitting early EOS or tokenization edge with long numeric sequences.

anika: Confirmed — I ran the same eval against ceres-7b-fp16 and failure rate is 0.6%. So new quant pipeline likely culprit (quant-pipeline v1.4 rolled yesterday).

devin: Can we bisect to the quant change? If quick rollback is possible, pin production to ceres-7b-fp16 or previous int8 v1.3.

liam: Creating a quick perf/sanity job to compare v1.3 vs v1.4 on the structured-output seeds. Will post results in ~15m. :hourglass:

sam: Opening internal ticket INF-4021 with samples, eval logs, and suggested owner tags. Assigning @anika as triage owner and @liam for repro/bench.

anika: Action items: (1) reproduce and capture logits for failing cases, (2) try decoding tweaks (no eos bias, increase top_k), (3) coordinate rollback if needed. ETA 3 hours. :mag:

devin: Thanks — tagging infra-oncall if we need immediate pin. @eng-oncall please standby. :phone:

eval-bot: Added alert annotation: owner=anika, priority=P2, ticket=INF-4021

maya: Quick note — include long-context seeds; structured-output suite hits long numeric sequences which may token-split differently under new BPE handling.

anika: Will include token-level diffs. Updating ticket now.

liam: Results: v1.3 int8 failure rate 0.9% vs v1.4 11.8% (same seeds). Sending artifact links.

devin: Ok that confirms regression. Plan: pin to v1.3 for nightly rollouts and hotfix quant pipeline. We'll reconvene after anika's logs. :white_check_mark:
